question.text: Unsystematic risk is MOSTLY mitigated by:

explanation.text: The Logic: Unsystematic risk declines with diversification. The Trap: Leverage/fees/holding-period changes don't reduce firm-specific risk. Cross-Exam Context: Core portfolio-theory principle in X-A, XV. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Portfolios with 25-35 stocks capture most diversification benefit.
